body:
Runner trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-30, B' full gate test-f0ee2474 on Windows B). Windows B's SYSTEM git config sets core.autocrlf=true, plus core.symlinks=false, so every runner worktree there has CRLF working files. My CHECK lines use the normal config and showed clean. But the launcher measures under an isolated config (GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=NUL, GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1). There, `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` listed 1515 " M" line-ending-only files. So results.source.clean=false, and input.json's statusSha256, trackedIndexDiffSha256 and trackedHeadDiffSha256 were non-empty.
Consequence: such a checkout does not byte-equal the commit, so it fails the test-ref rule ("index and tracked files equal the commit") and isn't valid landing evidence.
Rules:
- Check runner cleanliness the way the launcher does, with the isolated env: `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=NUL GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1 git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` must be empty.
- On a Windows runner, set core.autocrlf=false in the runner clone's own .git/config (with the coordinator's word), then use fresh worktrees.
